_doc: P3g - the execution workflow's ticket table: the clauses that must each have a passing, signed judge ticket on the SAME judged frame before a phase may close (`pinebox phase --close NAME`). `pinebox verify --phase NAME` judges exactly these clauses. A ticket closes one phase only (P3 section 0: 'Reuse one ticket across phases' is a forgery).

ema-ribbon.doc: the EMA ribbon script draws both moving averages and its crossover markers

week-jul.doc: the time axis shows the July fixture week
